::: {#exr-chebyshev-simulation}

#### Simulated misses of the sample mean

Draw 10,000 samples of the size from @exr-chebyshev-min-n with replacement,
and report how many of the sample [means](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-mean) $\samplemean{X}{n}$ miss $\mean$ by 1 or more.

:::
